scripts.text: Anyways, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?
What favor?

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:
Um...Ah..It's...
A little...complicated...
- Arc looks around to check if someone else is around. Satisfied you're alone he continues with his story in a low tone. -

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text: Frankly, I'm worried about a friend of mine who left without permission saying that she's going to check on your camp. She hasn't come back since then.

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text: But, I can't leave this post to look for her 'cause I have a duty to guard the research data stored here.

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text: Since she left without permission, I can't even report to my superiors... that will just end up as a bigger problem.

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:
The thought of it just worries me...
As a matter of fact, we are trying not to have any contact with the giants of Manuk so we stay away from each other's territory.

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text: That camp of yours is located in the area that has been acting as the neutral zone between our two races...

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:
If she has gotten close to their side then she might have gone over to the snow fields...
That will make it even more difficult for us to look for her...

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text: The Manuk giants might misunderstand this as provoking them...Couldn't they?

So...the point is, you want me to look for your friend. Right?
Because you can't do it yourself from all these complicated situations?

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:
Exactly!
You're quite observant.
Sure, I will do it.
Sorry, can't help you.
But, I'm going to need more information if I'm going to look for her.

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:

^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:

If you find a trail of knotted plants it should lead you to where she is.

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:

Please, I beg of you.

scripts.speaker: Arc

scripts.speaker: Arc

scripts.speaker: Arc
scripts.text:
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.

{0}!

I will take some things to treat the wounds with me and if it turns out that the captured Laphine is Terra, I will bring her back.
